fields.System.Title: TRF-302 — Validate against what was sent
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a receiving clerk at the destination, I want the system to compare what arrived with
what was sent, so that a difference is caught at the dock rather than at a stock count.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a receipt, then received quantities are compared line by line against the
  • dispatch record.
  • - Given an exact match, then the transfer closes and no discrepancy is raised.
  • - Given a shortfall or excess, then a discrepancy record is created — see
  • [TRF-403](TRF-403-record-discrepancy.md).
  • - Given a discrepancy, then the system does not automatically adjust either side's
  • stock.
  • - Given a product received that was not dispatched, then it is recorded as an unexpected
  • item and quarantined.
  • - Given a batch mismatch, then it is treated as a discrepancy even when quantities agree.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | transfers |
| Tables | transfer_receipt, transfer_shipment |
| Risks | Quantity mismatch auto-adjusted, hiding theft or picking errors ([doc 09 §9.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
